collection.title: Mazda 5 2011 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mazda 5 2011 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" wiper blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this Mazda 5, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
